page: Microsoft Azure NV72ads_A10_v5 is an x86_64 architecture server powered by dedicated AMD processors and managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. This instance features 72 dedicated vCPUs and a substantial memory footprint of 880.0 GB, yielding approximately 12.22 GB of RAM per core.

The server is equipped with two NVIDIA A10 GPUs, providing a combined total of 45 GB of VRAM. For local storage, it includes a 2949 GB SSD, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high density of memory, dedicated AMD processing cores, and dual NVIDIA A10 GPUs, this server offers a resource-dense profile for workloads requiring both significant graphics acceleration and large memory capacity. It is designed for workloads such as GPU-accelerated databases, deep learning inference, data science pipelines, and heavy visualization tasks.
